about_page.title: About Fennec
about_page.subtitle: We make films that stay with people.
about_page.p1: Fennec Productions was founded in Benghazi in 2025. We work in commercials, corporate films, documentaries, and digital storytelling, combining cinematic craft with clear, considered communication.
about_page.p2: Narrative integrity, established before the first frame. We invest in research and structure so that every visual choice serves the story.
about_page.p3: A Discipline of Research and Craft. We maintain clarity, respect deadlines, and treat visual language as a strategic tool.
about_page.p4: Libyan stories, told with international craft.
about_page.team_desc: A small core team leads every project, supported by a wider network of filmmakers, cinematographers, editors, and motion designers who join us as the work demands.

approach.title: Methodology
approach.desc: Six stages take a project from a first conversation to a finished film. Each one matters.

stages.s1_desc: We begin by understanding your goals, your audience, and what you actually need the film to do.
stages.s2_desc: The story takes shape. We develop the narrative, write the script, and define the visual direction.
stages.s3_desc: Locations, cast, crew, schedule, equipment. Every detail gets locked in before filming begins.
stages.s4_desc: Filming, directed with intention and shot with cinematic discipline.
stages.s5_desc: Editing, colour, sound, music, and motion. The film is shaped frame by frame.
stages.s6_desc: Final files in the formats you need, ready for release.
